Full skill text at 5★
Deals (200% of Frost Specter's ATK + 50000) Direct DMG to all enemies and inflicts 1 layer of [Bite of Fox Fire] on them for 3 turns. ([Bite of Fox Fire]: Each layers reduces Mastery and Crit DMG by 30%, up to 2 layers can be owned.) Each layer of [Bite of Fox Fire] reduces the owner's SPD by 8%. Frost Specter inflicts 1 layer of [Bite of Fox Fire] on all enemies immediately at the beginning of each wave. At the beginning of each wave or for every 3 times the skill is cast, Frost Specter inflicts [Freeze] on the enemy with the highest DMG dealt for 1 turn. Increases the Max limit of [Bite of Fox Fire] to 3 layers. For every 2 layers of [Bite of Fox Fire] inflicted, there is a 100% chance to inflict [Cold II] for 2 turns (this effect has an extra 180% Effect Hit). [Freeze] inflicted on enemies by Frost Specter for the first time cannot be blocked or cleansed.
Source: game files.

How to obtain

Free-to-play
  • Guild Store — Selection chest: 10 Souls for 20,000 Guild Coins. Limit 1; store refreshes every 30 days.
  • Elemental Market — Selection chest: 10 Souls. Limit 1; store refreshes every 30 days.
  • Homestead Market — Selection chest: 10 Souls for 100,000 Homestead Coins. Limit 1; store refreshes every 30 days.
  • Hero Quests — Selection chest of 5 Souls at 1,100 quest points.
  • Spirit Beast Cultivation — Limited-time event. Free track: 10 Souls (random chance); a paid track is also available.
  • Purgatory of Seven Sins — first-clear reward, Difficulty 50 (5 Souls)
Paid
  • Monthly Card — every 7 days of claimed rewards: Soul of Spirit Beast Selection Chest (pick 1 Soul of this Spirit Beast).
  • Battle Order — Level 50 paid track: selection chest of 10 Souls.
  • Group Benefit — Selection chest of 5 Souls at 200 progress (plus Random Spirit Beast Shards at 40 and 80 progress).
  • Advanced Combat Pass — Selection chest of 10 Souls each season.
  • Huge Discount — Ultimate Pack: selection chest of 50 Souls.
